Widget Design Minor

The minor needs 20 credits.

Required Courses12 credits
Select one (1) course from the following courses:
WDGT2000WIDGETS III4
or WDGT2050
and complete the following two courses:
WDGT2100WIDGET LAB4
WDGT2200WIDGET THEORY4
Elective Requirement8 credits
Select two of the following:
WDGT3000SPINNING & TURNING4
WDGT3200GEARBOX DESIGN4
Any 3000-level WDGT course also counts.
Total Credits20
